reviews.name: 0.4sDelayCryoMines
reviews.description: Reduces Zhukov Cryo Minelets arming time to roughly 0.4 seconds, randomized between 0.3 and 0.5 seconds.

evidence.finding: Default ArmingDelay=0.4; GetArmed calls the graph that delays by RandomFloatInRange(ArmingDelay-0.1, ArmingDelay+0.1). Installed vanilla default is 0.8. Arming is distinct from the subsequent detonation delay.

reviews.name: LootSansSummerName
reviews.description: Renames normal Loot Bugs to “Azuki-San” and changes their description to “Adorable! <3”; Golden Loot Bugs are unchanged.

evidence.finding: InitCave spawns LootSans_Main. Its construction script loads the normal Loot Bug Enemy component and assigns InGameName=Azuki-San and InGameDescription=Adorable! <3; there is only one target path.

reviews.name: LootSansSummerName_WithGoldenSans
reviews.description: Renames normal and Golden Loot Bugs to “Azuki-San” and “Golden Azuki-San”, with matching custom descriptions.

evidence.finding: Construction script iterates normal and Gold Enemy component paths; index 0 assigns Azuki-San/Adorable! <3 and index 1 assigns Golden Azuki-San/Kawaii! <3.

reviews.name: NoAmmoBar
reviews.description: Hides the segmented ammo-supply bars in the HUD.

evidence.finding: Both hashes remove the supply-bar content. One replaces ITM_SupplyBar and ITM_SupplyBarItem with empty actors; the other removes ProgressBar, ProgressChunks and all SupplyBarItem widgets, and SetProgress returns immediately. Vanilla contains these widgets.

reviews.name: alwaysSprint
reviews.description: Automatically sets the running state while not firing and enables client-authoritative movement on player characters.

evidence.finding: OnCharacterMovementUpdated handler sets IsRunning=!isFiring. Fire/secondary-fire delegates update isFiring. The repeating setWalkSpeed path iterates player characters and sets bServerAcceptClientAuthoritativePosition=true.

reviews.name: Sprint
reviews.description: Raises forward walking speed to sprint speed when no movement-slowing status is active.

evidence.finding: MoveForward input traverses PawnStatsComponent.Stats to detect two slowing stat types below 1. The positive-axis/no-slow branch selects MaxWalkSpeed=435; otherwise it selects 300. The original attached post also identifies autosprint and altered weapon slowdowns.

reviews.name: WindowMarker
reviews.description: Automatically outlines enemies seen by players and retains marked targets for 20 seconds; activation is restricted by a Steam-ID check.

evidence.finding: Both package versions contain the same enemy-outline graph: player-camera LineTraceSingle, FSDPawn attitude filter, AddOutlineComponent/OL_ENEMY, and timed outline cleanup. OnMarkerPlaced records expiry at Now()+20s. BeginPlay only enables ticking after a Steam-ID hash comparison succeeds; default ticking is disabled.

evidence.finding: Normal and Gold Health.MaxHealth=999999 and InvulnerableToNonDefinedResistances=true. Normal MaxPawnSpeed=3000, DamageLootDropChance=0; Gold ChunkCountRange and ChunkValueRange are zero. Compared with vanilla. This is not an audio-removal mod.

reviews.name: LionheartedLittleLootSans
reviews.description: Gives Loot Bugs 999,999 health, speeds up normal ones, suppresses hit and Golden Loot Bug drops, and renames normal Loot Bugs to “Azuki-San”.

evidence.finding: Contains the Lionhearted health, movement and drop changes. Normal Enemy_GEN_VARIABLE.InGameName.CultureInvariantString=Azuki-San; the release thread identifies this as the Azuki-San variant. No sound assets or audio deletions are present.

reviews.name: nuke_range_indicator
reviews.description: Adds a visible ring to the lingering radiation-cloud effect and reduces the brightness of Fat Boy’s cloud light.

evidence.finding: Radioactive cloud particle adds a fourth mesh emitter referencing M_ExplosionRange_butgreen. Fat Boy BP_MiniNuke_RadiationCloud PointLight.Intensity changes from 350 to 20 and radius from 900 to 800. This describes lingering radiation, not the initial blast radius.

reviews.name: revolverSound
reviews.description: Replaces the Bulldog revolver’s first-person firing sound with three custom gunshot samples selected at random.

evidence.finding: FP_RevolverFire_Cue FirstNode routes through the preserved mixer/modulator to SoundNodeRandom_3, whose three wave players reference the packaged famas_01/02/03 SoundWaves. No claim is made about their source game or audible character.

reviews.name: 500IWNoCooldown
reviews.description: Sets Iron Will to 500 uses with no cooldown between activations.

evidence.finding: PERK_IronWill.MaxUseCharges=500 and CoolDownBetweenUse=0, compared with vanilla values 1 and 1 respectively.

reviews.name: 30tickrate
reviews.description: Sets pathfinding enemies and their movement components to a 0.03-second tick interval, about 33 updates per second.

evidence.finding: Repeating one-second timer finds EnemyDeepPathfinderCharacter actors and calls SetActorTickInterval(0.03), then DeepPathfinderMovement.SetComponentTickInterval(0.03). It does not set the global server tick rate.

reviews.name: AutoPlatformGun
reviews.description: Makes the Platform Gun fully automatic at two shots per second and removes its rate-of-fire upgrade choice.

evidence.finding: Default HasAutomaticFire=true and RateOfFire=2 versus vanilla RateOfFire=1. Tier-one UpgradeTiers removes UPG_PlatformGun_D_Rof while retaining the ammo and magazine choices.

reviews.name: AutoPlatformGunAntiSchmorp
reviews.description: Makes the Platform Gun fully automatic at 1.5 shots per second and removes its rate-of-fire upgrade choice.

evidence.finding: Default HasAutomaticFire=true and RateOfFire=1.5 versus vanilla RateOfFire=1. Tier-one UpgradeTiers removes UPG_PlatformGun_D_Rof; this differs from the two-shots-per-second AutoPlatformGun file.

reviews.name: asch_P
reviews.description: Raises the PGL’s Spiky Grenade upgrade bonus to 890 direct damage.

evidence.finding: The single packaged asset is a DamageUpgrade named Spiky Grenade with Amount=890; the vanilla counterpart has Amount=60. This is an upgrade bonus, not total grenade damage.

reviews.name: CrippledCrawlers
reviews.description: Reduces Core Spawn Crawler melee base damage from 9 to 6.

evidence.finding: Enemy.InGameName.CultureInvariantString=Core Spawn Crawler. MeleeAttack/DamageComponent_0.Damage=6 versus vanilla 9. This is not a Glyphid Swarmer change.

reviews.name: CoilGunFear2m_P
reviews.description: Sets both the Coil Gun’s fear radius upgrade and shockwave range upgrade to 2 metres.

evidence.finding: UPG_Coilgun_ImpactFearRadius UpgradeType=EImpactFearRadius, Amount=200. UPG_Coilgun_ShotWidth3m UpgradeType=EShotwaveRange, Amount=200. Both vanilla counterparts have Amount=500. Both changes must be described.

evidence.finding: ITM_MenuBackground ColorAndOpacity.A=0.45 versus 0.7, BlurStrength=7 versus 15. MENU_EscapeMenu explicitly hides/disables BTN_DLC, BTN_Merch, BTN_Modding; Menu_StatusScreen hides the season logo and bottom smoke/gradient. Briefing layout is repositioned.

reviews.name: instantziplineboost
reviews.description: Removes the activation delay before gaining speed when riding down a zipline.

evidence.finding: Default__BP_ZipLineState_C.SpeedBoostActivationDuration=0 versus vanilla 0.25. The named state property controls boost activation duration, not zipline maximum speed.

reviews.name: friendlyfungusgeyser
reviews.description: Disables Fungus Bogs geyser damage and makes the interval between eruptions extremely long.

evidence.finding: Damage.RadialDamage, DamageRadius and MaxDamageRadius are all zero; Idle Min / Max is 100000/100000 versus vanilla 3/7. No claim is made that the geyser can never erupt.

reviews.name: FSD-WindowsNoEditor 实 提高帧率 核弹屏蔽光效_P
reviews.description: Removes the light emitted by Fat Boy’s lingering radiation cloud.

evidence.finding: The packaged Fat Boy cloud Blueprint sets its PointLight intensity, attenuation radius and falloff exponent to zero. Its name suggests performance, but no frame-rate improvement is asserted.

reviews.name: FSD-WindowsNoEditor-照明枪亮度和范围增加
reviews.description: Increases Scout flare brightness and extends its light radius from 35 to 75 metres.

evidence.finding: PointLight_NoShadow.AttenuationRadius=7500 versus vanilla 3500 and Intensity=4.5 versus 3.5. Distances are Unreal centimetres. This is the flare-gun projectile, not the handheld flare or flashlight.

reviews.name: FSD-WindowsNoEditor[客机]去除长时电浆粒子效果
reviews.description: Hides the lingering particle effect from the EPC’s Persistent Plasma overclock.

evidence.finding: The packaged P_ChargedProjectile_Persistance has no Emitters array, versus the active ParticleSpriteEmitter_2 in vanilla. It packages the particle only, without the projectile damage logic.

reviews.name: Minigun2xammo
reviews.description: Halves Minigun ammo consumption per shot and increases movement speed while firing from 50% to 75%.

evidence.finding: The sole packaged weapon has ShotCost=1 versus vanilla 2, and MovementRateWhileUsing=0.75 versus 0.5. The reserve ammo capacity is not doubled; consumption is halved.

reviews.name: MenaceProjFix
reviews.description: Keeps Glyphid Menace projectiles visible up to 150 metres instead of 50 metres.

evidence.finding: Projectile mesh CachedMaxDrawDistance and LDMaxDrawDistance both change from 5000 to 15000 Unreal centimetres. It does not increase projectile range or damage.

reviews.name: maximalTerrainScanner
reviews.description: Raises the terrain scanner to 1024×1024 resolution with a wider field of view and full-scene capture.

evidence.finding: TerrainScannerCapture.FOVAngle=45 versus 35 and PrimitiveRenderMode=PRM_RenderScenePrimitives versus PRM_UseShowOnlyList. BP_MapRenderTarget2D.SizeX/SizeY=1024 versus 304; render-target LOD group changes too.

reviews.name: Hack_Node_No_Delay
reviews.description: Shortens hacking transmitter-node connection delay to 0.1 seconds.

evidence.finding: Default__BP_TransmitterNode_C.ConnectionDelay=0.1 versus vanilla 0.9. Despite its filename, the remaining delay is nonzero.

evidence.finding: All four Octoberfest_2023 armor definitions set CanOnlyUseDefaultArmorMaterial=false and omit SeasonalEventTag and bIsFestiveItem versus vanilla seasonal-tagged festive definitions.
